note: Files are copied byte-for-byte from cyberwave-frontend at the pinned ref. Their internal '@/...' import specifiers are NOT rewritten — see vite.config.ts resolve.alias and tsconfig.json paths, which map those specifiers to the sibling files below instead. Never hand-edit these files; re-run scripts/sync_vendor.sh against a new ref and diff before overwriting (TWIN_PREVIEW_TOOL_PLAN.md §3.6).

files.why: Core teleop math: applyKeyboardJointBindingDelta, getJointStepSize, clampJointValue — the exact logic that decides how a key press moves a joint in the real frontend.
physicalPositionRange/wrapToPi — how joint limits clamp a commanded value.
CONTROLLABLE_JOINT_TYPES and schema<->URDF joint name resolution.
isControllableUrdfJoint — excludes native/schema mimic slaves from independent control, same rule the real controllable-joint list uses.
URDFAssetData shape, for reference/type-parity only — twin-preview does not need every field.

Transitive dependency of keyboard-joint-bindings.ts. twin-preview runs in 'simulate' mode (see §3 of the plan), where the leash is a no-op passthrough, but the file is vendored whole rather than stubbed to keep the import surface real.

Transitive type-only dependency of motion.ts. Renamed from motion.ts to motion-types.ts only because this flat vendor/ directory can't hold two files named motion.ts (utils/motion.ts and types/motion.ts upstream); content is untouched, see the alias mapping in vite.config.ts / tsconfig.json.
